title: com.docker.sandbox/clipboard@1
description: Config schema for the host clipboard. Singleton. Without config the sandbox has a normal clipboard: every media type, both directions. Each field narrows one direction to the listed media types; an empty list turns that direction off, and an entry turning both off is refused. The @1 names the capability contract, including this config schema and observable behavior. RELEASES.md defines when versions move and the maintainer-approved draft-stage exception.

read.description: Media types the sandbox may read from the host clipboard. Omitted admits every type; an empty list admits none.

write.description: Media types the sandbox may put on the host clipboard. Omitted admits every type; an empty list admits none.

anyOf.description: A canonical media type, type/*, or */*. Aliases are refused: a filter states each type by its canonical name.
